intro: Need a safe haven for your important documents? Look no further than the Centigaurd 1060 Fire Safe! With top-notch fire resistance and cutting-edge security features, you can rest easy knowing your valuables and documents are protected from fire, theft, and tampering.

features.title: Ultrakey double locking mechanism
features.text: Double the security, double the peace of mind. The Ultrakey double locking mechanism offers superior protection with a dual-lock design, ensuring reliable security for your precious documents.

features.title: 3-way live shooting bolt
features.text: Triple protection for your belongings. Equipped with 3-way live shooting bolts—four front, one top, and one bottom bolt—this safe is reinforced for unbeatable security against unauthorized access.In addition, the safe is reinforced by 4 Rear Fixed Shooting Bolts.

features.title: Fire resistant safe certified by ECB-S
features.text: Fireproof assurance for your valuables. Certified by ECB-S, this safe offers 90 minutes of fire resistance, keeping your documents protected even in the harshest conditions.

features.title: Double-walled body & door
features.text: Strength built to withstand. The double-walled body and door are packed with fire-resistant material, significantly slowing heat transfer, keeping your documents safe and secure during a fire.

features.title: Advanced snap shut mechanism
features.text: Effortless security with the snap-shut mechanism that ensures a secure and smooth closure, enhancing safety while providing easy access to your belongings.

features.title: Removable shelf for customizable storage
features.text: Adaptable organization. The removable shelf allows you to adjust your storage to fit taller items, providing a customizable and organized space for your valuables.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. It is Recommended to anchor the Locker with bolts from the bottom as well as the back into a cupboard or onto the wall.
